verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any in-product AI feature that generates insights or suggestions from a user's billing data. The hosted MCP server lets an external agent query and act on Orb data, which is a building block for the user's own agent rather than in-product AI insights. Revenue forecasting and expansion spotting are not described as AI-generated, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
